'''Star Tours Flight 4''' was the designation of a flight from [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to the [[Tomorrowland Starport]] around the time of the [[Battle of Death Star III]]. The spacecraft needed decontamination once it arrived.<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{C|California only}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This flight was listed on an arrivals and departures board found exclusively in the queue of [[Disneyland]]'s version of the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction.<ref name="Backside of Water">{{Blogspot|subdomain=backsideofwater|url=2008/06/now-arriving-from-hoth.html|name=The Backside of Water blog|text=Now arriving from Hoth}}</ref>
